ch07.d.preset: How the net force on the block changes with position
ch07.d.bars: Shows the work done by the net force and the change in kinetic energy as two bars side by side
ch07.goal.area: Work = area under the $F(x)$ graph (negative where force and displacement point opposite ways)
ch07.goal.theorem: Work-kinetic energy theorem: the work done by the net force $W_\text{net}$ = the change in kinetic energy $\Delta K$
ch07.obs.equal: The area under $F(x)$, the $\Delta K$ bar on $K(x)$ and the two bars on the right always agree
ch07.obs.neg: Piecewise: where the force opposes the motion the area is negative (hatched) and $K$ decreases
ch07.obs.spring: Spring: positive work for $x < 0$ raises $K$, negative work for $x > 0$ lowers it, and on the way back $K$ rises again
ch07.obs.custom: Custom: drag the handles on the $F(x)$ graph up or down to set the force on each segment. If $K$ reaches 0 the block turns back
ch07.assume: Block mass 2 kg, frictionless horizontal track, initial speed 1 m/s (spring: $k = 2$ N/m, starts at rest at $x = -2$ m, one period shown)
